parts:
Dear all,

apologies for this blatant case of self-advertisement :)

But I'd like to mention that we just received the AHM2 proofs from Academic Press. Today, we send out single or multiple chapters to those of you who volunteered to help proof-reading a while ago.

Expected publication date of the AHM2 book is April 2020.

Thanks and best regards  ---- Marc
